findings.message: Undertow usage detected; Boot 4 no longer supports embedded Undertow. Confirm effective container and replace supported starter if applicable.
Undertow-specific setting server.undertow.accesslog.dir will not configure Tomcat; suggested target is a review candidate only
Undertow-specific setting server.undertow.options.socket.TCP_NODELAY will not configure Tomcat; suggested target is a review candidate only
Undertow-specific setting server.undertow.threads.worker will not configure Tomcat; suggested target is a review candidate only
Undertow-specific setting server.undertow.threads.io will not configure Tomcat; suggested target is a review candidate only
Undertow-specific setting server.undertow.accesslog.enabled will not configure Tomcat; suggested target is a review candidate only
Undertow-specific setting server.undertow.no-request-timeout will not configure Tomcat; suggested target is a review candidate only
Undertow-specific setting server.undertow.max-http-post-size will not configure Tomcat; suggested target is a review candidate only
Compare documented defaults with the measured source/target runtime; do not equate values across servers
MANUAL_OBJECTMAPPER: check whether Spring properties can reach this mapper

undertow_to_tomcat.note: Tomcat relative paths are interpreted relative to its base directory.
Undertow/XNIO option has no documented one-to-one Tomcat mapping; review manually.
Worker models differ. Never copy worker count directly; load-test and consider virtual threads.
Undertow I/O threads have no direct Tomcat property equivalent.
Both enable access logging; compare actual logging behaviour.
Idle-without-request and keep-alive timeouts are not an exact semantic match. Do not auto-copy.
Undertow HTTP POST size and Tomcat FORM POST size have different scopes.

default_comparisons.note: Undertow I/O threads are not Tomcat request workers.
Tomcat worker model; with virtual threads enabled max does not control the same thing.
Equal-looking default size does not mean equivalent request-body semantics.
Explicit configuration and log output format still need examination.
File name and rotation may change without explicit settings.
Do not add properties unless filename contract requires it.
Actual decoded request behavior must still be compared.

default_comparisons.source_default: not documented at Spring property level; server runtime dependent
default_comparisons.target_default: UNKNOWN_FOR_EXACT_4.1_TARGET (4.0 reference: derived from connection-timeout unless overridden)
default_comparisons.note: Do not fabricate a numeric timeout from absent config.

warnings: Static application files are NOT sufficient to establish effective configuration: environment, profile activation, @Bean customizers, config server, command-line, Kubernetes and JVM options may override.
Maven POM entries are declarations, not a resolved dependency tree. Run Maven with the project's approved repositories for exact artifact versions.
Scanner never edits source files or auto-applies candidate Tomcat properties.
